blocks.value: EQUIPMENT CERTIFIED: CLASS VII FORKLIFT, CONSTRUCTION TELEHANDLER
has completed a 20 hours specialized forklift training for construction sites between 10 March
to 30 May 2025 and passed the prescribed assesments.
Training conducted in accordance with OSHA Standard 29 CFR 1910.178 and meets construction site-specific equipment safety protocols.
